_comment: ActiveWiki configuration — copy to activewiki.json and adjust paths
_wikis_comment: Root directory containing: inbox/, sources/, wiki/, vectordb/, logs/, scripts/

scopes._scopes_comment: Path to scopes.json (sessionKey → allowed scopes mapping). See scopes.json.example.

embeddings._comment: index_path is relative to wikis_root. Default: vectordb/index.sqlite

ocr._comment: Python venv with docling installed. Leave empty to use system python3.

llm._comment: LLM for distillation (wiki page generation from raw documents). 'url' is the OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

graph._comment: KG: incremental saves time on daily runs. Communities rebuild only when >threshold new entities.

distill._comment: After distilling all new sources: bottom-up rollup of wiki hierarchy?

ingest._comment: Hard deadline in local time. Distillation stops here; vector/graph build continues.

quality_check._comment: LLM timeout per call in the nightly quality check (scripts/check.py). Env ACTIVEWIKI_CHECK_TIMEOUT overrides this value; script default without config key is 120s. Retry logic unchanged: one retry after ~10s pause on timeout.
